summary: Otter, founded in 2020 and headquartered in Beverly Hills, CA, offers a multichannel restaurant technology platform that aggregates orders from 100+ delivery/ordering channels and can route them into 50+ integrated POS systems, alongside its own POS product line.

Otter publishes three pricing tiers per location: Starter ($79/month, basic POS + inventory + included hardware), Advanced ($178/month, adds order management/online ordering/QR ordering), and Professional ($278/month, adds website builder/loyalty/gift cards), with a $100/month minimum processing fee for locations under $25,000 in monthly card volume.

Otter names Wingstop, Jack in the Box, Denny's, Hummus Republic, Skyline Chili, Flavor District, Yemen Cafe, and Mustard's Last Stand among its restaurant customers on its own marketing site. (Scope note: Named-brand logos on a vendor marketing page indicate some level of relationship (e.g., a specific integration or pilot) but not necessarily full enterprise-wide POS replacement; scope of each named relationship was not independently confirmed.)
